fields.name: task
fields.note: Discriminator — always 'resolve_bom'. Any other value is not a valid BomQuery.

fields.name: bom_items
fields.note: Items to price. Each item: name (string, the ingredient or material), qty (number, quantity required), unit (string, e.g. kg/L/g/unit), role (string, e.g. substrate/solvent/packaging). Optional per-item: stage_id, cas_number, inci_name.

fields.name: process_context
fields.note: Optional process context. Fields: process_name (string), production_scale (string: small_batch | pilot | industrial). Absence is treated as production_scale=small_batch.

fields.name: currency
fields.note: ISO 4217 currency code for pricing output (default EUR). If the oracle cannot price in the requested currency it prices in EUR and notes the deviation.
